name: justinj-industries-website
description: Lightweight QA toolchain for JustinJ Industries static website

scripts.check:a11y: npm run build && start-server-and-test serve http://127.0.0.1:8080 "pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080 --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000 && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080/about/ --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000 && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080/policies/ --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000 && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080/work/ --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000 && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080/government-buyers/ --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000 && pa11y http://127.0.0.1:8080/capability-statement/ --standard WCAG2AA --timeout 120000"
scripts.check: npm run check:footer && npm run check:html && npm run check:links && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:format
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.check:footer: node scripts/sync-footer.mjs && prettier --check assets/site-footer.css partials/site-footer.html scripts/sync-footer.mjs
